policy_descriptions.single-shot: Broad deterministic collection over all discovered services, then one diagnosis call.
policy_descriptions.react: Model chooses tools iteratively within the same source and observation limits.
policy_descriptions.investigator: Iterative investigation with runtime hypothesis bookkeeping; structural checks are not semantic judging.

order: case/repeat order; policy order rotates by case index plus repeat index
provider_contract: One model request per complete(); built-in HTTP retries disabled.
label_boundary: Labels used for manifest validation/scoring only; policies receive tools, never labels.
warnings: Synthetic fixtures and local fault captures are reported separately; neither represents production incident diversity.

metric_notes.cause_match: Exact cause_code equality; explanation semantics are not scored.
metric_notes.root_service_match: Exact component equality when the label specifies root_service; None otherwise.
metric_notes.required_evidence_recall: Fraction of label-required IDs both cited and observed; None if the label requires no IDs. Aggregate is a mean over cases with required IDs.
metric_notes.citation_traceability: Fraction of distinct cited IDs present in observed; None for no citations. Aggregate is weighted by citation count. This is NOT semantic support accuracy.
metric_notes.abstention_correct: For abstaining reports only: the label and reported cause both equal insufficient_evidence. None otherwise. Evidence coverage is checked separately by task_success, including on insufficient_evidence cases.
metric_notes.task_success: Completed valid report, exact cause and (when labeled) root_service match, all required evidence cited and observed, and no unobserved citations. A diagnosis requires citations. Every evidence_groups group must have an observed citation, and no known numeric audit issue may remain. An empty-citation abstention can pass only if its label requires no evidence. This is not full semantic correctness.
metric_notes.numeric_audit: Conservative rules for known numeric risks; zero findings does not certify all narrative claims.
metric_notes.numeric_rejection_count: Rejected diagnosis or hypothesis submissions with numeric findings; includes repaired and ultimately failed runs.
metric_notes.evidence_groups_recall: Fraction of evaluator-defined alternative-evidence groups with at least one observed citation; all groups are required.
metric_notes.usage: Reported token totals; partial totals are marked usage_complete=false.

single-shot.wilson_note: Descriptive only when repeats or related cases share group_id; not independent trials.

latency_seconds.scope: wall time of attempted runs, including failed runs; excludes unattempted rows

single-shot.cost_note: Tokens only; no invented monetary cost. Missing usage produces partial, lower-bound totals.
